```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)

knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  fig.width = 6,
  fig.asp = .6,
  out.width = "90%"
)

theme_set(theme_minimal() + theme(legend.position = "bottom"))

options(
  ggplot2.continuous.colour = "viridis",
  ggplot2.continuous.fill = "viridis"
)

scale_colour_discrete = scale_colour_viridis_d
scale_fill_discrete = scale_fill_viridis_d
```



```{r}
library(rvest)
library(httr)
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
url = "https://www.samhsa.gov/data/sites/default/files/NSDUHsaeShortTermCHG2015/NSDUHsaeShortTermCHG2015.htm"
drug_use_html = read_html(url)

drug_use_html
```

```{r}
drug_use_html |> 
  html_table()
```

if we want only the first table
```{r}
marj_df =
  drug_use_html |> 
  html_table() |> 
  first() |> 
  slice(-1)
```

# water (use APIs)

getting a csv

```{r}

# minimize how many times you aske server to get you something -- sepearte the html code from other code 

nyc_water = 
  GET("https://data.cityofnewyork.us/api/v3/views/ia2d-e54m/query.json") |> 
  content("parsed") 
```

getting a json file

```{r}
nyc_water_json = 
  GET("https://data.cityofnewyork.us/api/v3/views/ia2d-e54m/query.json")

nyc_water_json |> 
  content("text") |> 
  jsonlite::fromJSON() |>
  as_tibble()
```

# pokemon API

```{r}
pokemon =

  content()

pokemon[["name"]]
```
